card.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
card.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For tonight's courtyard film, you fold the moon; I'll switch off the lamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the crescent. It already has a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll own the moon. Can I tell the audience we're waiting for your blackout?

mechanism: A bargains to keep B responsible for the impossible moon blackout while volunteering only feasible production work.
confusable: Unlike generic delegation, A must resist taking back the impossible component and secure B's ownership of it.
comparison: The eligible moon scene bargains over public responsibility; D149-b is protected context only and receives no saved assessment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
